messages:
Marta: Heads up — seeing ~12% throughput regression on INT8 vs FP8 runs for the embed-heavy workload after quant sweep. Dumped traces, looks like KV cache behavior differs. Anyone around to sanity-check reproduction steps?
Kevin: On it. Can you paste the exact bench command and sample inputs?
Marta: Running on staging-gpu-3, power cap 250W. Command:
```
./bench_runner --model rwinf-gpt-7b --quant int8 --batch-size 4 --seq 1024 --warmup 300 --profile=perf.json --kv-cache on
```
Input is 512-token prompts sampled from prod prompt set (tokenization checked). For FP8 I used same command with `--quant fp8` and identical seeds.
Sahil: Did you pin kernel selection or let runtime auto-select?
Marta: Auto-select. Profile shows different kernel for attention matmul at layer 6 under INT8 (`int8_gemm_v1`) vs FP8 (`fp8_gemm_opt`) and heavy fallback to fp32 on certain blocks.
Jen: Can you paste the profiler snippet? even 5 lines.
Marta: Profiler excerpt:
```
layer6.attn: int8_gemm_v1 chosen (120ms) -> fallback_fp32 for kv_reduce (45ms)
layer7.ffn: fp32_gemm fallback (80ms)
kv_cache.copy: 32ms (INT8), 14ms (FP8)
batching.overhead: 6ms
```
Zane: kv_cache.copy doubling is suspect. Are we re-allocating buffers on quant path? check allocator logs (enable --alloc-trace).
Lucy: Also check tokenization differences — mixed tokenizers can change token counts even with same seed. Did you run `--dump-tokens`?
Marta: Yup tokens match. Dump attached in perf.json. Alloc trace shows `realloc` on cache when seq > 512 for int8 path.
Kevin: Hypothesis: int8 kernels require extra alignment for scratch buffers causing realloc on longer sequences -> extra memcpy -> throughput hit. Also kernel selector policy might prefer int8_gemm_v1 which has higher latency for the sequence lengths we use.
Sahil: Quick experiment suggestion: force kernel selector to prefer `int8_gemm_v2` (if available) and run warmup 1000 to stabilize power/thermal. Also try `--kv-cache-prealloc` flag.
Marta: Running those now. Launching job 1975004321-try1.
ci-bot: Job queued on staging-gpu-3, id 24681.
Marta: Try1 results: throughput recovered ~9% after `--kv-cache-prealloc`, full recovery + warmup 1000 gave parity with FP8.
Jen: Nice. So primary culprit seems buffer reallocation on int8 path + insufficient warmup to hit steady thermal/power state.
Zane: Action items:
- Add kv prealloc by default for quantized kernels when sequence variance > 256
- Add heuristic in kernel selector to prefer v2 for seq distribution where v1 falls behind
- Add a failing unit test that reproduces realloc pattern
Kevin: I'll open a PR for selector heuristic. Sahil will add prealloc toggle.
Sahil: Yep I'll do prealloc and add alloc-trace to nightly quant-bench.
Marta: Thanks all. I'll update the quant-benchmark playbook with: warmup >= 1k, enforce token dumps, alloc-trace on regressions, and a note about kernel selector parity checks. :thumbsup:
Lucy: Worth adding a small doc blurb about power cap interplay — 250W vs 200W showed larger deltas in our runs.
Marta: Good point. I'll add that too.
Kevin: Reassigning follow-ups in issue tracker.
Marta: Closing thread, will post the PR links here when available.
